name: Jonas Petrov
headline: Analytics Engineer
summary: Analytics Engineer focused on building reliable data pipelines and decision-ready reporting. Comfortable working across Agile teams to shape system design, streamline ETL flows, and turn raw data into trusted metrics. Known for pragmatic automation, clear documentation, and close collaboration with product and operations stakeholders.

roles.title: Analytics Engineer
bullets: Built ETL pipelines in Azure with SQL and pandas to consolidate operational feeds into governed reporting tables.
Automated data preparation tasks with Bash, reducing manual work by 35% and improving refresh reliability.
Partnered on system design decisions for the analytics layer, aligning SQL models with downstream reporting needs.
Improved quality checks across Azure workflows and ETL runs, cutting broken loads by 28% through clearer validation steps.
Worked in Agile delivery cycles with the backend and product teams to ship metric changes faster and keep dashboards consistent.
